title: MPFA: A Pareto Front Approximation Method for Riemannian Bi-objective Optimization
summary: We propose a Pareto front approximation (MPFA) method for smooth bi-objective optimization problems on Riemannian manifolds based on a Hermite interpolation technique. Compared with the existing multiobjective optimization numerical algorithms, the proposed method can generate a continuous approximate Pareto front without multiple initial points. We establish convergence of the proposed method and analyze the approximation error of the resulting Pareto front.
